name: arifOS Federation Observability Failure Graph
doctrine: Void Guard · Honest Failure Modes · Blast Radius Containment

failure_modes.trigger: Reboot, OOM, or missing config file on disk
failure_modes.observed_reality: Config was missing from disk for 13 days while process ran in RAM. Now restored.
failure_modes.blast_radius: ZERO for production ingestion (organs publish directly to NATS, bypassing collector).
failure_modes.remediation: Reconstructed yaml on disk; marked STATUS=STANDBY, AUTHORITY=HOLD.

failure_modes.trigger: Daemon crash, port conflict, disk full
failure_modes.blast_radius: Telemetry stream halts. Producers fall back silently to avoid blocking agent execution.
failure_modes.remediation: Systemd auto-restart (nats-server.service). JetStream persistence on NVMe.

failure_modes.trigger: Container crash, connection saturation, disk volume full
failure_modes.blast_radius: Kabarkan Worker fails asyncpg connection. Messages back up in JetStream.
failure_modes.fail_mode: QUEUE_BUFFERING (NATS holds messages until Postgres resumes)
failure_modes.remediation: Docker restart policy 'always'. Worker retries with exponential backoff.

failure_modes.trigger: Python unhandled exception, syntax error in payload
failure_modes.blast_radius: Postgres writes pause. NATS JetStream consumer lag increases.
failure_modes.severity: MEDIUM (Zero data loss within retention limits)
failure_modes.remediation: systemd Restart=always, RestartSec=5. Replay from JetStream ack floor.

failure_modes.trigger: Timer disabled/inactive, unhandled exception in probe loop
failure_modes.observed_reality: Frozen for 48 hours (Sep 13-15) because frame-probe.timer was not active.
failure_modes.blast_radius: Silent blindness. Execution proceeds normally, but drift and FQ trends are unrecorded.
failure_modes.remediation: Enable and verify frame-probe.timer. Monitor trends.jsonl modification mtime.

failure_modes.observed_reality: Reports generated in forge_work but failed to copy into digest_inbox.
failure_modes.blast_radius: Sovereign visibility gap. Digest is produced but not displayed to Hermes briefing.

failure_modes.trigger: Actor FQ divergence, verification deficit, runaway consecutive execution
failure_modes.observed_reality: 333-AGI held due to FQ=5.00 (FOSSILIZED); qwen-code held due to FQ=0.67.
failure_modes.blast_radius: Restricted actors cannot execute tools until verification barrier clears.
failure_modes.remediation: Execute verify cycles; arifFlow cooling watchdog automatically checks cooldown.
